decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is the flagship of the firm's organic direction and builds directly on its core curing and maturation know-how, so the firm can read its results and refine it well.

The premium salami snack line draws on existing salami expertise and was extended with a poultry variant in 2024, though the snack format is newer to the firm and moved from its own page to a mention, which signals some risk.
Organic Fleischwurst is a classic boiled sausage closely tied to the firm's traditional recipes and fits its expansion of organic lines, so it is likely to get time to establish itself.

Thinly sliced organic chicken breast fits the organic and ingredient-conscious trend, but poultry slicing is further from the firm's core salami and sausage knowledge and the organic poultry snack was already withdrawn, so the risk is moderate.
Organic herb-coated salami combines the firm's in-house seasoning and maturation strengths with its organic strategy, making it easy to assimilate and improve.
